title: npm client prefers cached metadata over the registry
description: .npmrc declares a client setting that reuses cached package metadata instead of asking the registry. Revoked or unpublished versions keep resolving from the cache, so a change made on the registry never reaches the build.
remediation: Leave `prefer-offline` off for release builds and use a controlled cache with an integrity policy.
limitation: It matches a client setting that reuses cached package metadata instead of asking the registry in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
